title: いっしょにかぞえよう (Issho ni Kazoeyou)
description: A warm count-together story following a child and parent through their day, counting one thing at each moment — from 1 sun at wake-up to 10 stars at bedtime. Each item is introduced with 'ikutsu aru kana?' inviting the reader to count along using both native Japanese and Sino-Japanese number words.
author: オリジナル
